description: A React component named DetailsViewer that renders detailed views of objects or arrays with features like collapsible sections, formatted fields, copy-to-clipboard, and raw JSON toggle.

classes.name: DetailsViewer
classes.description: A reusable React component for displaying structured object details with collapsible sections, formatting, and interaction features.

methods.name: safePretty
methods.description: Returns a pretty-printed JSON string of the payload with fallback options.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Converts a key to a formatted label using formatLabel utility.

methods.name: isTimestampLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a timestamp field.

methods.name: isTokenLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a token count field.

methods.name: isDurationLike
methods.description: Checks if a key resembles a duration or latency field.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a duration string, handling seconds and milliseconds.

methods.name: isCurrencyKeyLoose
methods.description: Determines if a key is related to currency or cost fields.

methods.name: formatValueByKey
methods.description: Formats a value based on its key, applying special formatting for currency, tokens, timestamps, and durations.

methods.name: initialCollapsed
methods.description: Decides if a section should be collapsed based on depth and collapsedDepth prop.

methods.name: Collapser
methods.description: A React component for collapsible sections with toggle button.

methods.name: renderPrimitiveVal
methods.description: Renders a primitive value with formatting and styling.

methods.name: extractAgentIdentity
methods.description: Extracts agent ID and name from an object if available.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders a node (object, array, primitive) with collapsible sections for arrays/objects.

methods.name: renderEntries
methods.description: Renders key-value entries of an object, with highlighted keys first.
